runs.label: preservation-audit
runs.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import difflib,hashlib,json,os,socket
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('build/uc001-priority5w-country-mismatch-ui')
baseline=json.loads((p/'preservation-baseline.json').read_text())
changed=[];missing=[]
for name,expected in baseline.items():
 f=Path(name)
 if not f.is_file(): missing.append(name)
 elif hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=expected: changed.append(name)
assert not missing,missing
assert set(changed)=={'docs/TASKS.md','tests/e2e/saved-comparison.spec.ts'},changed
links=json.loads((p/'directory-symlinks-before.json').read_text())
assert all(Path(name).is_symlink() and os.readlink(name)==target for name,target in links.items())
prior=(p/'before/tests/e2e/saved-comparison.spec.ts').read_text();current=Path('tests/e2e/saved-comparison.spec.ts').read_text()
start=current.index("test('mocked selected-country mismatch permits explicit LI correction")
end=current.index("test('malformed CH postcode requires correction",start)
assert current[:start]+current[end:]==prior
prior=(p/'before/docs/TASKS.md').read_text();current=Path('docs/TASKS.md').read_text()
def without_current_authorization(text):
 start=text.index('Current authorization, 2026-10-23:');end=text.index('Previous authorization, extended 2026-10-19:',start)
 return text[:start]+text[end:]
start=current.index('## Priority 5W —');end=current.index('## Priority 3 — bounded contracts/policy',start)
assert without_current_authorization(current[:start]+current[end:])==without_current_authorization(prior)
assert [line for line in prior.splitlines() if line.rstrip()!=line]==[line for line in current.splitlines() if line.rstrip()!=line]
for name in changed:
 before=(p/'before'/name).read_text().splitlines();after=Path(name).read_text().splitlines()
 additions=[line[1:] for line in difflib.unified_diff(before,after,n=0) if line.startswith('+') and not line.startswith('+++')]
 assert all(line.rstrip()==line for line in additions),name
for name in ('git-status','git-branch','git-head','git-index'):
 assert (p/(name+'-before.txt')).read_bytes()==(p/(name+'.txt')).read_bytes(),name
ports={}
for port in (8011,5175):
 with socket.socket() as s:
  s.settimeout(1);ports[str(port)]=s.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1',port))!=0
assert all(ports.values()),ports
report={'recorded_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'baseline_files':len(baseline),'unchanged_files':len(baseline)-len(changed),'changed_files':sorted(changed),'missing_files':missing,'directory_symlinks_preserved':len(links),'entire_prior_browser_file_byte_preserved_after_removing_one_new_case':True,'dated_TASKS_history_and_original_whitespace_preserved':True,'no_new_whitespace_in_slice_delta':True,'branch_HEAD_index_and_status_bytes_unchanged':True,'owned_test_ports_closed':ports,'final_changed_file_sha256':{name:hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in sorted(changed)}}
(p/'preservation-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='final_changed_file_sha256'},indent=2))
PY
runs.result: 1752 baseline files:1750 unchanged, only TASKS and one existing browser test file changed, none missing; one directory symlink preserved. Entire prior browser file/history preserved; ports 8011/5175 closed.

runs.label: artifact-checks
runs.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,sqlite3
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('build/uc001-priority5w-country-mismatch-ui')
files=list(p.rglob('*.json'))
for f in files: json.loads(f.read_text())
r=json.loads((p/'verification.json').read_text());a=json.loads((p/'preservation-audit.json').read_text());c=json.loads((p/'case-contract.json').read_text())
e=json.loads(Path(r['actual_browser_case']['artifact']).read_text());report=json.loads((p/'browser-first-run.json').read_text())
assert r['phase']==3 and r['status']=='in-progress'
assert Path('docs/TASKS.md').read_text().startswith('PHASE: 3\nSTATUS: in-progress\n')
assert datetime.fromisoformat(c['recorded_before_test_at'])<datetime.fromisoformat(report['stats']['startTime'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
assert e['mismatch_input']=={'mocked':True,**c['mocked_response']}
assert e['matched_association']==c['expected_single_match']
assert e['request_counts']=={'after_mismatch':1,'after_country_edit':1,'after_explicit_submission':2,'mocked_responses':1,'actual_backend_requests_forwarded':1}
assert report['stats']['expected']==2 and report['stats']['unexpected']==0 and report['stats']['flaky']==0
for name,expected in a['final_changed_file_sha256'].items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,name
for name in ('commands.json','preservation-audit.json','case-contract.json','git-status.txt','git-diff-check.txt'): assert (p/name).is_file(),name
assert (Path('docs')/'../build/uc001-priority5w-country-mismatch-ui/verification.json').resolve().is_file()
assert not list(p.rglob('*.har')) and not list(p.rglob('*trace*.zip'))
secrets=set()
with sqlite3.connect('build/test-only/uc001-priority5w-mismatch-ui.sqlite3') as connection:
 for row in connection.execute('SELECT submission_key_digest,proof_binding,payload_digest FROM search_request'):secrets.update(row)
 counts={table:connection.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM '+table).fetchone()[0] for table in ('search_request','request_alternative','request_alternative_evidence')}
assert counts==e['after']['counts']
texts=[f for f in p.rglob('*') if f.is_file() and f.suffix in ('.json','.txt','.md','.ts')]
leaks=[str(f) for f in texts if any(secret in f.read_text() for secret in secrets)]
assert not leaks,leaks
result={'JSON_files_parsed':len(files),'pretest_contract_recorded_before_execution':True,'exact_mock_and_expected_LI_association_match':True,'first_run_two_passes_no_retries':True,'target_POSTs':{'mocked':1,'actual':1,'total':2},'actual_database_counts':counts,'final_source_hashes_and_receipt_links_valid':True,'actual_persisted_submission_digests_or_bindings_in_text_artifacts':0,'trace_HAR_exports':0,'phase_3_in_progress':True}
(p/'artifact-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
PY
